stimuli.adaptation: Private paraphrase for a concise candidate stimulus; one unsupported added claim about Pip’s local knowledge/ability to escape was removed. Question meanings and answer support must be rederived from this version. Not the original CBSE passage.
stimuli.text: At dusk, Pip is alone in a marsh churchyard near the sea. A rough, frightened-looking man with an iron on his leg seizes him and turns him so Pip must look up helplessly. The man asks about a file and food, then orders Pip to bring both the next morning. Pip is cold, wet, shaking and afraid. The man demands, ‘Tell us your name! Quick! Give it mouth!’ He warns, ‘Keep still, or I’ll make you pay!’

items.subject: accountancy
items.question: Pali Limited offered 2,00,000 shares of ₹10 each at a premium of ₹2 per share. Applications were received for 1,95,000 shares, which were duly allotted. The amount was payable as ₹3 on application (including ₹1 premium), ₹6 on allotment (including ₹1 premium), and the balance on call. Manoj, holding 6,000 shares, failed to pay allotment money and his shares were immediately forfeited. Out of the forfeited shares, 4,000 shares were re-issued at ₹11 per share as fully paid up. What is the amount of Capital Reserve?
items.construction_note: Restored the one omitted payment-schedule detail from the original question paper; options retained as transcribed. CBSE SQP-derived, not a CUET PYQ.

items.subject: business_studies
items.question: Mr Gun Amroha, the General Manager of Welworth Textiles, scans the business environment and adapts the organisation to changes taking place in different dimensions of the business environment. However, it is still difficult for him to accurately assess future trends. Identify the limitation of planning related to the above.

options.label: B
options.text: Planning may not work in a dynamic environment.
